patterns.note: The site features a stark contrast between an extremely airy, minimalist hero section and a subsequent dense, irregular grid of diverse project images that fills the remaining page content.
The hero section uses an oversized, almost full-width heading for the designer's name, creating a bold and impactful initial statement.
A monochrome base of white background and black text provides a clean canvas, allowing the vibrant and diverse colors within the project images to stand out as the primary visual interest.
A minimal header containing a hamburger menu and a 'Start project' call-to-action remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
The main content area is a continuous, unsegmented flow of project thumbnails, presented without explicit section dividers or headings, creating a gallery-like experience.

technique_notes: A sticky header with a hamburger menu and a call-to-action link remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, while the main content scrolls underneath it. Content sections, primarily a dense grid of project images, reveal statically as they enter the viewport, without additional scroll-triggered animations like fade-ins or slides. Any detected css-keyframes are likely used for subtle hover effects or initial page load animations not visible in the scroll sequence.

design_tokens.type_scale: An extremely oversized, bold hero heading (~8x body) dominates the initial view, with body text and labels in a standard, clean sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp corners, with very subtle rounding on some product images or interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: A very airy hero section with generous whitespace transitions into an extremely dense grid of project images with minimal guttering, followed by a balanced footer.

standout: The site's distinctiveness lies in the dramatic shift from an ultra-minimalist, oversized typographic hero to an overwhelming, maximalist, and visually rich collage of diverse project work. This contrast effectively showcases both a refined aesthetic and a vast portfolio range.
